research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Everlaw is researching systems for document analysis and review. In Providing overlapping time redactions in media items, it develops techniques to manage overlapping time range redactions in digital video without losing underlying redaction data. Document difference viewing and navigation focuses on automatic comparison and navigation across large sets of documents in review workflows. Conversation Graphs addresses visualization and analysis of communication threads. Together these efforts advance media redaction, document comparison, and conversation analysis.

overview_description.description:
Everlaw is a legal technology company that provides a platform for document analysis to law firms, government, and corporations. It is a cloud-based litigation platform for corporate counsels, litigators, and government attorneys that enables teams to discover, reveal, and act on information to drive internal investigations and positively impact the outcome of the litigation.

The company combines speed, security, and ease-of-use into a comprehensive solution that unlocks the collaborative power of teams and allows them to investigate issues more thoroughly, uncover a truth more quickly, and present their findings more clearly.

It was established in 2010 and is headquartered in Oakland, California.
